title: Enchantments
blurb: Every enchantment in the game, with its maximum level. Treasure enchantments cannot be found at an enchanting table and are marked in the wiki's own data.
note: 43 enchantments in 26.2. Flat list rather than the grouped-by-applicability form the later Phase 7 bullet describes — that grouping needs a tree-shaped section the flat member list cannot express. Icon borrowed from the Enchanted Book. This is the same fallback the enchantment pages themselves use: the game draws every enchanted book with one texture, so the icon marks the kind rather than claiming to tell one enchantment from another.
